text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Nihon Derby. Unfazed by 
the "Bourbon" chants echoing through the 
venue, Mihono Bourbon remains calm and 
collected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to catch up to Mihono Bourbon 
today of all days, Rice Shower shows 
unprecedented drive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In contrast, Mihono Bourbon maintained her 
composure, steadily focusing solely on 
victory. And so, the curtain rose on the 
race—
